mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, warehouse_id, material_id, qty, create_time AS move_time, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m') AS period FROM inv_movement WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m') <= #{toPeriod} ORDER BY create_time, id

SELECT w.id, w.order_no, w.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, w.qty, w.finish_qty, w.status, w.plan_start_date, w.plan_end_date FROM mrp_work_order w LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = w.material_id WHERE w.deleted = 0
AND (w.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND w.status = #{status}
ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT w.id, w.order_no, w.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, w.qty, w.finish_qty, w.status, w.plan_start_date, w.plan_end_date FROM mrp_work_order w LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = w.material_id WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = 'hr_piece_wage_detail'
SELECT w.id, w.work_order_id, w.employee_id, w.amount FROM hr_piece_wage_detail w WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} ORDER BY w.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_voucher (voucher_no, voucher_date, word, attachment_count, total_debit, total_credit, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{voucherNo}, #{voucherDate}, #{word}, 0, #{totalDebit}, #{totalCredit}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{userId}, NOW(), 0)

INSERT INTO fin_voucher_entry (voucher_id, line_no, summary, subject_id, debit_amount, credit_amount, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{voucherId}, #{lineNo}, #{summary}, #{subjectId}, #{debitAmount}, #{creditAmount}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{userId}, NOW(), 0)
